description: If an ordinary total computable \(g\) satisfies \(e\in J(A)\Longleftrightarrow g(e)\in J(B)\), then both exact composites \(g\circ q_1\) and \(g\circ q_0\) are ordinarily computable and satisfy \(x\in A\Longleftrightarrow g(q_1(x))\in J(B)\) and \(x\notin A\Longleftrightarrow g(q_0(x))\in J(B)\) for every \(x\), where \(q_1,q_0\) are the fixed query-and-gate maps.
